messages:
Leah Kim: hey team, first day hiccup — Kandji enrollment hangs on 'Downloading profiles' when i'm plugged into the wall port at my desk. If i switch to wifi it works. macOS 14.4. Any quick fixes?

Lena (IT): welcome Leah! do you see a captive portal page or an error? can you run `sudo fdesetup status` to check FileVault?

Leah Kim: no FV prompt yet. when wired it pops a browser redirect to office-guest.example.com (accept terms) and then enrollment never proceeds. `sudo fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off".

Jordan (Device Admin): captive portal explains it. Kandji needs outbound HTTPS to our enrollment endpoints during initial install. Options: (1) enroll on wifi/hotspot then replug ethernet, or (2) NetOps can add a short-lived MAC whitelist to bypass the portal for onboarding. Which do you prefer?

NetOps Bot: To request whitelist, reply with device serial or MAC and we'll add a 24h onboarding exception.

Leah Kim: serial C02LKX123456 — i can wait for NetOps if that's easiest.

NetOps Bot: Whitelist added for serial C02LKX123456 on onboarding VLAN, expires in 24h.

Kandji-bot: Enrollment attempt recorded for "Leah Kim - MacBookAir14" at 2026-12-07T09:02:15Z.

Leah Kim: retried wired after NetOps change and enrollment completed! saw FileVault prompt and Okta device appears. thanks all :tada:

Lena (IT): perfect — Jordan, can you add a one-line KB: "If you hit captive portal on wired OOBE, request NetOps onboarding whitelist or enroll over wifi."

Jordan (Device Admin): will add KB and note for new-hire checklist.

Leah Kim: thanks everyone — excited to be here :wave:
